title: Many-to-many Matching with Cluster-Approximated Spatial Constraints
authors: with Özgür Yılmaz and Ömer Faruk Şahin
summary: We characterize when spatially constrained many-to-many allocations remain completable, develop a maximum-flow feasibility test, and propose a completion-preserving priority mechanism that delivers feasible, Pareto-efficient, and stable allocations.

title: The Worst-Rank Frontier in Discrete Resource Allocation: No-Envy, Ordinal Efficiency, and Probabilistic Serial
summary: We characterize the smallest worst rank compatible with no-envy and ordinal efficiency, derive sharp rank-loss bounds, and show that Probabilistic Serial can lie far from the optimal no-envy, efficiency, and joint frontiers.

title: Equitable Affirmative Action in School Choice
summary: Ongoing work on the design of equitable affirmative-action policies in school choice.

title: Is the Weighted Sum a Meritocratic Method? A Mechanism Design Approach to Research Assistant Recruitment in Turkey
summary: A mechanism-design perspective on weighted-score recruitment, asking when aggregate scoring can meaningfully be interpreted as meritocratic.
